source: All 12 authored Word references, training/corpus-review.json and frontend/vendor/paper-layout.js
format_scope: Measured family defaults, not a promise that every mixed-font paragraph in a reference has one font or size. Original Word export retains its original run properties.

objects.tables: Native Word cells, observed column proportions, multiline cell text, explicit repeating headers. Unchanged Word inputs also retain original merges.
objects.grids: Native editable grids with physical counts validated at several image scales. Conflicting measurements are left for image verification. Unclear-only cells in matched, detected-empty groups become blank.
objects.shapes: Editable native basic geometry. Complex scanned artwork retains original source pixels.
objects.pictures: Separate original assets, aspect ratio retained and observed alignment. School banner crops exclude measured editable header-field tables and separate marks boxes. Never fabricated.
objects.emphasis: Preserve meaningful native question underlines and boxed cues. Resolve editorial replacements and insertions into clean final wording; omit cancelled drafts, strikes and editorial highlighting.

source_word_export.retains: Original package parts, fonts, styles, image bytes, numbering, equations, links, headers, footers, native shapes and tables.
source_word_export.a4_adjustments: All section sizes/margins; fit oversized inline drawings/tables; keep section headings with their first question; put floating tables in page flow; avoid wrapping text beside wide anchored objects.
source_word_export.limits: Original source composition defects can remain. Native fonts require availability in the opening application. Browser extraction preview is not an exact Word rendering. Any teacher edit switches to the automatic paper formatter.

verification.handwriting_accuracy: Not certified by layout tests. See training/LIVE_REVIEW.md.
verification.exact_pdf_word_pairs: Do not pair different assessments simply because the subject/class matches.
verification.training_method: Reference rules, prompts and deterministic layout; no hosted weight fine-tuning performed.

automatic_reading.detail_views: Up to three bounded enlarged overlapping image regions accompany the independent visual verifier; they are not additional pages. Crop coordinates remain on the full page.
automatic_reading.page_order: Use unique printed page numbers when available, otherwise a sole real exam header followed by section I may precede continuation pages. Missing/duplicate evidence never invents a page number.
automatic_reading.rows: Read each physical row left to right, retain original question numbering including source mistakes, and keep short question columns as native rows.
automatic_reading.validation: Do not count escaped blank rules or unreadable placeholders as source question content. Reject verification that turns a known question stem into a blank.
automatic_reading.export_text: Download Word rebuilds the current optional text-editor snapshot. Token provenance prevents repeated Hindi edits from changing a different table cell or geometry/image metadata. Explicit Indic fonts and language tags retain script shaping.
automatic_reading.suggestions: Automatically use the selected text and nearby language context; allow English inside Hindi and context-supported Romanized native-language spelling. Preserve numbers/equations and never supply answers. Suggestions do not change wording until selected.
